remarks: Discover this charming 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom condo, perfectly situated just moments from town. Flooded with natural light, this inviting space features an open layout that maximizes comfort and functionality. The well-appointed kitchen flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, creating an ideal setting for both relaxation and entertaining. With its convenient location, you're just steps away from shopping, dining, parks, tennis and the train, making it a great choice for commuters and city lovers alike. Whether you're looking for a smart investment property or a cozy place to be your home, this condo offers great value in a desirable area.
